# Project Hail Mary

By Weir.

- Favourite idea: write things down before you trust your memory.
- Worth rereading in a year, especially the chapter on planning.
- David recommended it after our conversation about focus.
- The middle part drags, the last third makes up for it.
- Not as good as the previous book by the same author.
- Key takeaway: decide what not to do before deciding what to do.
- A good book for a long flight.
